meta.title: Quality of democracy
meta.interval: 68% highest posterior density interval (V-Dem's codelow and codehigh), about one standard deviation
meta.aggregation: Each year's value is the day-weighted mean of V-Dem's country-date estimates
meta.regional: Median and quartiles of the other countries in each set, never including Poland; null where fewer than 5 report

regions.about: Comparison sets for the analyses in this repo. Members are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, as in V-Dem's country_text_id. Central and Eastern Europe is the 11 post-communist EU member states; Western Europe is the other 16 EU member states and the United Kingdom, the same two sets as Party ideology's east and west. Change a set here and raise the version.

we.description: The other EU member states and the United Kingdom

rollcall.note: distance: PiS against PO/KO MPs on the first dimension of the linked dynamic IRT of every non-lopsided roll call, in pooled SD units. opposed: share of contested roll calls on which the PiS and PO/KO club lines were opposed. Intervals are vote-bootstrap percentiles and are lower bounds.
